th-1016-1.text:
Nerves before a fight don't mean you're not ready.

They mean your body knows it matters.

The fighters who look calm aren't fearless. They just stopped reading fear as a stop sign.

th-1016-2.text:
Honest question for the fighters here.

What's the round you dread most in training?

First round cold, the middle grind, or the last one when everything's gone?

th-1016-3.text:
No coach? Film every session.

You can't fix what you can't see. Watch it the same day, pick one thing, fix only that this week.

One fix a week is 52 fixes a year.
